findings.summary: Graded, PMKVQ, and TurboTaper bit ledgers omitted the batch dimension, overstating compression for batch sizes above one.

Graded and ThinkV wrappers could compose with model-side sliding layers while returning retained rather than transient full K/V state for the active attention call.  The unsupported composition is now rejected before scoring.
ThinkV batch sizes above one warned and silently used DynamicCache, allowing an uncompressed run to be reported as ThinkV.  Unsupported batches now raise.
Cache reset did not consistently clear requantization cadence, delta-bit history, classifier/TBQ state, or accounting state, so repeated examples could depend on prior examples.
Malformed fake-roundtrip tuples/tensors, invalid skip-layer indices, invalid window parameters, invalid stored-bit metadata, and non-finite attention capture can no longer pass into evaluation.
Partial exact counters and legacy ratio-only values could collapse into an apparent FullKV/exact observation.  Exact counters, FullKV, and legacy ratios now have disjoint labels and validation.

LongBench, LongCodeQA, and RULER could average per-generation memory fractions.  Exact aggregation now computes sum(stored_bits)/sum(fp16_bits), which is the only weighting consistent with the bit ledger.
A valid zero-bit payload was variously treated as FullKV or divided by zero.  Positive fp16 baseline with zero stored bits now reports +infinity compression in common, code, and reasoning paths.

LongCodeQA allowed arbitrary non-empty revision and SHA strings to claim an official complete bracket.  Completeness now requires the pinned release revision, exact per-bracket SHA, protocol commit, and max_new_tokens=16.

Teacher-forcing and generation paths accepted malformed logits/output shape, empty tokenized prompts, empty references, invalid gold indices, or non-finite metrics.  These contracts are now validated before a score is emitted.
ThinkV attention capture could fall back to uniform behavior after missing modules/weights and still retain the algorithm label.  Missing or non-finite attention capture now aborts the evaluation.

Selection parameters accepted booleans/non-integral values and some full selections retained a subset label.  Exact integer validation and full-selection normalization now preserve benchmark provenance.
